build_SpaceTimeTransformer: build a SpaceTimeTransformer model with configurable num_frames, embed_dim, and depth for video classification
run_SpaceTimeTransformer_forward: run the SpaceTimeTransformer forward pass on a batch of video tensors with shape BxFxCxHxW
create_VideoPatchEmbed: create a VideoPatchEmbed module to project video frames into patch embeddings using a 2D convolution
review_VarAttention: review the VarAttention module that performs space-time attention with optional image-to-text cross-attention
refactor_SpaceTimeBlock: refactor the SpaceTimeBlock to customize the order of temporal and spatial attention operations
